info.longBusinessSummary: Ayalon Insurance Company Ltd, through its subsidiaries, provides various insurance products in Israel. It offers life insurance and long-term savings plans, such as pension savings insurance funds and savings policies; and general insurance cover products, including property, liability, marine, and third-party liability insurance, as well as medical expense, motor property insurance, property and third-party motor insurance, and property auto insurance. The company also provides health insurance products, including critical illness, nursing care, dental, personal accident, and medical insurance for foreign workers, and employer's, third-party, professional, directors and officers, and product liability insurance. In addition, it offers fire, engineering, and contractor works insurance; contractors' insurance; comprehensive insurance for businesses and offices; mechanical engineering equipment insurance; personal accident; mechanical breakdown, electronic equipment, and agricultural insurance; comprehensive insurance for apartments, including building insurance; cargo insurance in transportation, including marine, land, and water; vessel insurance; business; and cyber damage insurance. In addition, it is involved in transplants and special treatments; surgeries and alternative treatments; ambulatory coverage, including outpatient testing, consultation, and treatment; rapid diagnosis and advanced technology supplements; complementary medicine service letter; and child service letter. Ayalon Insurance Company Ltd was formerly known as Ayalon Holdings Ltd and changed its name to Ayalon Insurance Company Ltd in July 2022. The company was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Ramat Gan, Israel. Ayalon Insurance Company Ltd is a subsidiary of Wesure Global Tech Ltd.
